_doc: Per-object grasp profiles. A profile is chosen by the first 'match' substring found in the detected label, else 'default'. All lengths in mm. width_mm: nominal width across the jaws (null = use the width measured by locate.py). insert_depth_mm: how far BELOW the object's top face the fingertips go. approach_open_mm = width + approach_open_margin_mm (jaws open before descending). release_width_mm: jaw opening when placing. top_height_mm: height of the object's top face above the table (the grasp plane for pixel->3D). squeeze_mm: closing target = width - squeeze_mm.

gripper._doc: Linear map jaw opening (mm) -> gripper command (deg, as in get_observation 'gripper.pos'). PLACEHOLDER, calibrated=false: measure closed/open once with the real gripper and fill in. The planner warns while calibrated=false.
